Being ‘ready’ doesn’t mean spending all the time doing religious things.
For married couples, being ‘ready’ means being ready to listen to each other, sharing thoughts and feelings.
Keep your ‘love tank’ full by thinking of ways he or she can be surprised by love.

Could You Be a Welcomer?
We are looking for parishioners to welcome people to Mass, hand out missalettes and offer a friendly smile.
If you attend a weekend Mass, could you come a few minutes early to help?
Welcomers will serve in teams of two, and we hope to have a team at every weekend Mass.
A warm welcome helps everyone feel at home.

Archbishop Deunot Faviell In November each year we take the opportunity, on Share Appeal Sunday, to remind ourselves about the second collection taken up at weekend Masses throughout the year.
